card_en: Five to ten: pet, šest, sedem, osem, devet, deset. Teens end in -najst (petnajst), tens in -deset (petdeset), with dvajset for 20. In between, the unit comes first, joined by in: petindvajset, twenty-five. Sto is 100.

quick_check.explain_en: The unit comes first and in joins it to the ten, all in one word: petindvajset.

helper_de: Just like German fünfundzwanzig: the unit comes first and in joins it to the ten, petindvajset.
helper_en: English puts the ten first, twenty-five. Slovenian says five-and-twenty, as in the old English four-and-twenty.
